sources.title: Prowl README
sources.locator: Why Prowl; See every agent; Know who needs you; Reach other machines; Automate the loop; Let your agents drive; Requirements; Privacy & Telemetry; License
sources.finding: Native macOS 26+ command center for parallel coding agents: Canvas, Shelf, Agent Island, Active Agents, remote projects over SSH, agent profiles, workflows, prowl CLI, worktrees, diff and GitHub PR status; telemetry opt-outs; FSL-1.1-ALv2 license.

sources.title: Prowl LICENSE
sources.locator: Functional Source License 1.1, ALv2 Future License
sources.finding: FSL-1.1-ALv2: any use except a competing use; each version converts to Apache-2.0 two years after release; copyright Supabit LLC and onevcat and Prowl contributors.

sources.title: Prowl manual: concepts
sources.finding: Hierarchy of repositories, worktrees, tabs and panes with agent states Blocked, Done, Working and Idle.

sources.title: Prowl manual: agent-detection
sources.finding: Process probe and screen heuristics detect agents and their Working, Blocked, Idle or Done state, including Devin, Antigravity and remote agents over SSH.

sources.title: Prowl manual: active-agents
sources.finding: One roster of every agent across worktrees, tabs and splits with states and keyboard cycling.

sources.title: Prowl manual: agent-island
sources.finding: Notch or menu-bar roster showing counts by state with Blocked and Done cells that jump to the pane.

sources.title: Prowl manual: agent-profiles
sources.finding: Named launch presets per runtime (model, effort, execution mode, placement, env vars, dedicated home); seeded for each installed CLI; argv-only by default.

sources.title: Prowl manual: workflows
sources.locator: What it is; Built-in Review Loop; Script actions and bundles; Sandbox access; Built-in Handoff
sources.finding: Workflows (.pwlworkflow with workflow.yaml, schema prowl.workflow/v1) script live agent panes with roles, steps, typed state, loops and deliveries; built-in Review Loop (2-4 rounds default) and Handoff; history retained; size limits.

sources.title: Prowl manual: cli
sources.locator: Commands; prowl agents; dispatch completion and waiting; prowl workflow; Transport
sources.finding: prowl CLI talks to the running app over a Unix socket: list, read, send, key, focus, create tab/pane, close, open, canvas, agents (read, signal, dispatch, wait), profiles, skills, workflow; --json envelopes with schema_version and error codes.

sources.title: Prowl manual: canvas
sources.finding: Zoomable board where every open tab is a live terminal card with broadcast typing and finished-card highlight.

sources.title: Prowl manual: shelf
sources.finding: Worktrees shown as vertical spines with tabs and agent status markers.

sources.title: Prowl manual: remote-folders
sources.finding: Remote projects over the user ssh with nothing installed on the host; tabs are shells on the host; worktrees list for remote repositories.

sources.title: Prowl manual: repositories-and-worktrees
sources.locator: worktree creation; Setup script; archive script
sources.finding: First-class git worktrees created with Cmd-N; setup and archive scripts run on the worktree lifecycle.

sources.title: Prowl manual: diff-view
sources.finding: Diff window against HEAD and an Outgoing Changes mode against the PR base or configured base branch; read-only review of agent changes.

sources.title: Prowl manual: github-pull-requests
sources.finding: PR state, review decision, CI rollup, merge readiness and merge queue per worktree through the gh CLI; actions to mark ready, re-run failed jobs, copy failure logs, merge and close.

sources.title: Prowl manual: notifications
sources.locator: When a notification fires; Where unread shows up
sources.finding: macOS notifications when an agent finishes or asks, command-finished alerts (10 s default), bell and unread indicators, Dock badge and bounce.

sources.title: Prowl manual: custom-actions
sources.finding: Toolbar buttons with hotkeys for repeated commands, global or per repository.

sources.title: Prowl manual: updates
sources.finding: Sparkle auto-update with hourly background checks and explicit install confirmation; notarized releases; Homebrew cask separate.

sources.title: Prowl manual: terminal
sources.finding: Terminal panes rendered by libghostty with Ghostty config support.

sources.title: Prowl settings reference
sources.finding: analyticsEnabled (PostHog, default true, off in Debug) and crashReportsEnabled (Sentry, default true) settings.

sources.title: Prowl Remote Mirror
sources.locator: Enable and pair; Take Over; Listen on
sources.finding: Remote Mirror (alpha): off by default; paired iPhone or another Mac views and controls Host terminals over LAN or VPN with a 60-second pairing code and TLS; one remote owner per pane with explicit Take Over.

sources.title: Prowl Mirror clients
sources.finding: iOS and Android Remote Mirror clients are experimental native projects built from source in the repository; they add no targets to the Mac release pipeline.

sources.title: Prowl Mirror Android README
sources.finding: Android client builds a debug APK and is not yet a Play Store release configuration; MIT licensed.

sources.title: Prowl Mirror iOS README
sources.finding: iOS Mirror client has a make target that publishes to TestFlight via asc; no public join link in the pinned docs.

sources.title: Prowl App/Project.swift
sources.finding: XcodeGen/Tuist manifest for the native macOS app target.

sources.title: Prowl bundled skills
sources.finding: Bundled agent skills prowl-cli and prowl-workflow installed with prowl skills install and linked into the app bundle.

sources.finding: No web, Windows, Linux or browser client; Mac app is native with no web views (README); mobile clients are the experimental Mirror projects.

sources.title: Bounded search: team
sources.locator: grep -Ei for oauth login, saml, sso, organization role, guest, share link over App, CLI, Shared, Mirror, docs
sources.finding: No accounts, roles or SSO; Remote Mirror pairs devices of one user with one remote owner per pane.
